title: ymp run — first user command (MVP surface)
goal: The first user-facing product function: run a task through a real provider and report honestly.
scope: ymp run <goal> [--data-dir]: task, durable session, one admitted Codex invocation, honest report.
ymp show <session-id>: read the persisted session back (restart survival).
Unattended tests on the scripted backend; real invocation only behind the ignored test.
acceptance: Happy path, typed failure, not-ready registry and restart survival are tested without real providers.
Report states only observed facts (outcome, usage, session id, workspace).
context: Record created at launch per trunk policy; executor is a background full-access agent.
